environment.description: Tomcat 9.0.68 running on EC2 instance in private subnet. Application is accessed via an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only) that forwards TCP/8080 directly to the instance. Security group allows inbound 8080 from 10.0.0.0/8. PostgreSQL 14 RDS instance with db.r5.large, multi-AZ, connected via same VPC. The DB_USER has SELECT privileges on all tables (orders, inventory, payroll, audit_log). No query-level firewall or SQL proxy in the path.

config.database: PostgreSQL 14 RDS, DB_USER has SELECT on all tables
